name: StellarForge Development Container
postCreateCommand: rustup toolchain install && rustup default "$(sed -n 's/^channel = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' rust-toolchain.toml)" && curl -sSfL -o /tmp/stellar-cli.tar.gz "https://github.com/stellar/stellar-cli/releases/download/v${STELLAR_CLI_VERSION}/stellar-cli-${STELLAR_CLI_VERSION}-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz" && echo "${STELLAR_CLI_SHA256}  /tmp/stellar-cli.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict && sudo tar xzf /tmp/stellar-cli.tar.gz -C /usr/local/bin stellar && rm /tmp/stellar-cli.tar.gz && cd sdk && npm ci
